  [IsSemisimpleRing.{v} (Subtype.{v + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{v, v} A x)]

∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] (E : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} E] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} k E]
  [Module.Finite.{u, v} k E] (A : Subalgebra.{u, v} k (Module.End.{u, v} k E))
  [IsSemisimpleRing.{v} (Subtype.{v + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{v, v} A x)]

source_text: For a semisimple subalgebra A acting faithfully on E, its commutant is semisimple and its double commutant is A.
